name: Spectacle Everywhere
symptom: Every section competes for maximum visual intensity
replacement: Choose one signature stage and calmer supporting sections

name: Full-Page WebGL by Default
symptom: Heavy renderer used when still/media/layout would carry identity
replacement: Escalate media cost only when interaction/world continuity needs it

name: Feature Claims Before Proof
symptom: Marketing adjectives precede concrete code/UI/action evidence
replacement: Move truthful product evidence earlier

name: Decorative or Implausible Code
symptom: Code block looks technical but does not represent a believable API
replacement: Use syntactically/semantically plausible implementation proof

name: One Center Crop Everywhere
symptom: Same art crop used for portrait/landscape/ultrawide
replacement: Author focal points or asset variants by aspect ratio

name: Autoplay Video as Sole Proof
symptom: Important proof depends on ambient autoplay media
replacement: Use poster/still + explicit playback/action; content stays understandable

name: Crushed Comparison Table
symptom: Desktop comparison is scaled until columns/text are unreadable
replacement: Contain horizontal density inside component

name: Caveats Hidden in Footer
symptom: Confidence/provenance/freshness is far from the data it qualifies
replacement: Place evidence metadata adjacent to claims

name: Generic Futuristic AI Glow
symptom: Purple/blue glow substitutes for product-specific proof
replacement: Use operational/product evidence and one restrained accent system

name: Chat Transcript as Final Agent Proof
symptom: AI agent claim stops at conversational response
replacement: Show artifact/action/resulting state

name: Sticky Everything
symptom: Multiple sticky owners fight for viewport and scroll
replacement: Assign one sticky job or release on narrow screens

name: Template Residue Promoted as DNA
symptom: 404/demo/copy/vendor/editor/placeholder artifacts are treated as core design
replacement: Account for residue but quarantine from transferable patterns

name: Portfolio Outcomes Without Reflection
symptom: Case study shows final polish but hides decisions/tradeoffs/learning
replacement: Use reflective case arc

name: Experimental Interaction on Every Route
symptom: Drag/cursor/collage novelty contaminates contact/article/case usability
replacement: Isolate play in bounded surface/route

name: Vague Us-vs-Others Superiority
symptom: Comparison makes unverifiable superiority claims
replacement: Compare defensible dimensions only

name: Gaming Equals WebGL
symptom: Game/studio site adds renderer merely for genre association
replacement: Start with still art/crop/type/HUD; earn renderer complexity

name: HUD Chrome Over Content
symptom: Instrumentation becomes more prominent than story/action
replacement: Keep metadata secondary and reduce on mobile

name: Equal Scroll Distance for Unequal Beats
symptom: Every narrative chapter gets same dwell despite different reading/impact needs
replacement: Use weighted timeline and hold windows

name: Independent Story Clocks
symptom: Renderer/DOM/HUD/audio each derive state from separate scroll listeners
replacement: Use one authoritative progress bus

name: Maximum Renderer Quality on All Devices
symptom: DPR/particle/FX budget ignores runtime capability
replacement: Use adaptive renderer budget and semantic fallback

name: Integration Logo Wall as Sole Proof
symptom: Compatibility is claimed but setup/job details are absent
replacement: Provide implementation-oriented integration details

name: CMS Record Binding Drift
symptom: Slug/title/H1/body/metrics refer to different records
replacement: Run same-record invariants across whole route family

name: Unique Slug, Duplicate Body
symptom: Different article/detail routes silently reuse the same content
replacement: Run duplicate-content canary and inspect bindings

name: Desktop Media Preserved at Mobile Cost
symptom: Heavy desktop video/canvas survives mobile while content is cramped
replacement: Drop/reduce media before meaning; preserve semantic proof

name: Same Density on Every Route
symptom: Home, detail, pricing, legal, contact all use identical information density
replacement: Use route-family density ladder

name: Stale Legal/Placeholder Content
symptom: Old domains, unresolved jurisdiction/currency variables or template text stay public
replacement: Treat legal routes as release-critical content

name: Mascot Over Proof
symptom: cute creature/object identity becomes more prominent than client, scope, problem or result
replacement: Mnemonic Case-Study Encoding layered on conventional professional metadata

name: Metaphor Obscures the User Job
symptom: visitors cannot tell whether a world term means portfolio, service, category or contact
replacement: Metaphor Translation Contract with visible conventional cues and accessible names

name: Hover-Only Collection Meaning
symptom: project/category/action information exists only on pointer hover or card back
replacement: touch/focus reveal plus always-visible critical identity/action

name: Canonical Host Drift
symptom: public browsing host differs from canonical, sitemap and robots-advertised host
replacement: choose one public host, update canonical/sitemap/robots and verify redirects/share metadata

name: Visual Title Without Semantic H1
symptom: detail/article route uses a visually dominant H2 but exposes no meaningful H1
replacement: retain visual styling while restoring one route-specific H1 in semantic hierarchy

name: Cross-Section Template Identity Drift
symptom: hero, FAQ, contact, footer or metadata refer to different brands/verticals
replacement: Template Residue Firewall with one release-time identity/content invariant

name: Focusable DIV Without State Semantics
symptom: tab/accordion-like DIV is focusable but exposes no role or selected/expanded state
replacement: semantic button/tab controls with keyboard model and ARIA state

name: Placeholder GET-to-Self Form
symptom: lead/newsletter form submits user fields with GET to the current marketing route
replacement: real POST/server action or form provider with validation, status, privacy and spam controls

name: Dead Service Card Links
symptom: service cards visually promise navigation but all link back to ./
replacement: link each card to meaningful detail/action or remove false affordance

name: Root-Domain Campaign CTA Stubs
symptom: wishlist, trailer, social or legal actions point only to a platform root or example domain
replacement: resolve every high-intent label to the exact title/community/media/legal destination and verify before release

name: Anonymous Press Praise
symptom: promotional quotes use generic labels such as PRESS OUTLET with no attributable source
replacement: use named publication/person plus source URL/date or remove the quote

name: Mechanic H1 Role Abuse
symptom: component/mechanic labels are authored as repeated H1 elements beside the page H1
replacement: use one page-level H1 and appropriate H2/H3/list semantics for mechanic rows

name: Missing Home Document Language
symptom: the main localized page ships with an empty html lang attribute
replacement: set the correct document language on every authored route

name: Pointer Instruction Leaks to Touch
symptom: copy such as HOVER TO SURVEY remains visible on mobile/coarse-pointer layouts
replacement: switch instruction by input capability or remove the pointer-specific instruction when content works directly

name: Route Canonical Path Mismatch
symptom: an indexable route canonicalizes to a different/nonexistent path such as /startups -> /startup
replacement: canonicalize each intended indexable route to its deliberate canonical URL and test sitemap/canonical parity

name: Indexable Route Missing Canonical
symptom: sitemap route ships without canonical ownership
replacement: define canonical policy for work/category/tool/docs routes and verify every sitemap URL

name: Companion Surface Missing Document Language
symptom: rendered tool/docs pages have empty html lang
replacement: set the correct document language on every product/docs route

name: Visual Heading Fragment H1 Abuse
symptom: one visual phrase or supporting statement is split across multiple H1 elements
replacement: keep one semantic page H1 and style fragments/spans without changing document outline

name: Sitemap Declares 404 Destination
symptom: indexed sitemap includes /shop returning HTTP 404
replacement: automatically assert sitemap URLs return intended 200/redirect or remove retired URLs from sitemap

name: Repeated H1 in Route Families
symptom: several product/docs/migration/handbook pages contain multiple H1 elements in HTML
replacement: use one semantic page H1 and presentation-only subheads while preserving visual hierarchy

name: Documentation Nested Scroll Trap
symptom: fixed sidebars plus internally scrolling article may trap focus/anchors on small devices
replacement: test scroll ownership and accessible keyboard/anchor navigation for desktop and mobile

name: Cross-Vertical Store Fixtures in Game Catalog
symptom: toy beauty nail furnishing sports and drone products published under game library
replacement: quarantine sample fixtures and enforce a domain-specific CMS taxonomy before production

name: One Template Title Across All URLs
symptom: all 75 sitemap URLs expose title Battlez - Gaming Framer Template
replacement: route-specific article product category and core titles while preserving canonical ownership

name: Template Publisher Chrome Leaks into Product
symptom: BUY LICENCE overlay Framer editor promo and placeholder socials intrude into player funnel
replacement: remove preview/template artifacts and replace placeholder destinations before launch

name: Generic Cart Anchor Missing Button Semantics
symptom: Add To Cart uses anchor without href and often generic accessibility tree role
replacement: real button with accessible action keyboard activation and verified cart feedback

name: Monthly Yearly Switch Without Verified State
symptom: sampled switch click did not update displayed price or inactive state despite yearly discount label
replacement: wire state with semantic switch/radio and verify displayed units totals and accessible feedback

name: Zero Counter Placeholder as Proof
symptom: 0%/0.0x metrics appear until viewer scrolls and animates to nonzero claims
replacement: static meaningful initial text and reduced-motion state with legitimate sources for productivity claims

name: Free Trial CTA Lands on Contact Form
symptom: Try for free and plan Get started actions all open a qualifying contact form
replacement: label lead capture honestly or provide working trial/signup continuation

name: Reduced Motion Still Traverses Full Horizontal Survey
symptom: prefers-reduced-motion reduce still keeps sticky world and animates -3880px track on desktop
replacement: honor reduced motion with static/vertical ordered sector narrative and no pinned horizontal traversal

name: Visual Chapter Rail Active State Without ARIA
symptom: rail buttons mark current chapter using CSS is-active but lack aria-current or aria-pressed
replacement: update semantic current-step state alongside shared progress and keep rail buttons keyboard-accessible

name: Generic Framer Title on Twenty-One Routes
symptom: 21 of 43 sitemap URLs reuse Fizens - The Ultimate Finance SAAS Framer Template title
replacement: unique core/legal/partner SEO titles, preserve canonical

name: Four Job Routes Hardcode Product Designer H1
symptom: all 4 job details H1 Product Designer despite distinct routes and customized HTML titles
replacement: bind actual job role from CMS and test URL/title/H1 consistency

name: Multiple H1s for Hero Fragments and Prices
symptom: homepage 3 H1 fragments and pricing card dollar H1s beyond page heading
replacement: single semantic H1 with spans and prices as ordinary content

name: Generic App Store Pages Masquerade as Product Installs
symptom: homepage store badges link Apple App Store home and Google Play Games index
replacement: verify product-specific store destinations and actual released app

name: Fintech Claims and Template Publisher Chrome
symptom: vendor checkout and demo finance/security/wealth claims alongside consumer funnel
replacement: separate template marketplace and verify product claims/fixtures

name: Service CTA Loses Chosen Quest When Opening Contact
symptom: Website quest and Motion quest Accept this quest CTA go to /contact but dropdown defaults Identity quest; 2/3 misclassified
replacement: pass service identity on navigation and preselect matching contact option with visible confirmation and keyboard override

name: Published Sitemap Lists Authored HTTP 404 Page
symptom: tobi-mallory sitemap.xml declares /404 even though it returns proper HTTP 404 on both hosts
replacement: keep designed 404 route as recovery surface but exclude non-200 and noindex paths from sitemap; validate sitemap with actual HTTP responses

name: Demo Presented as a Live Agent
symptom: Simulated sample tasks appear to be authenticated agent runs
replacement: Explicit sample-data labels and separate real app CTA

name: Marketing Docs OS Availability Drift
symptom: Marketing advertises Windows/Linux while docs label unavailable or in development
replacement: Share dated OS compatibility truth across marketing and docs

name: Third-Party AI Costs Blended with App Credits
symptom: External API/subscription billed by another service is implied covered
replacement: Separate first-party credits and provider spend near price

name: Invented FAQ or Account Route
symptom: Assuming /faq /account /checkout exist; sampled 404
replacement: Navigate actual FAQ section and confirmed auth targets

name: Product World Stills Misread as Website 3D
symptom: BridgeVerse native 3D world screenshots are misread as live marketing WebGL
replacement: Validate renderer separately; use still proof when appropriate

name: Template Awards Taken as Real Outcomes
symptom: Designer demo awards/revenue/client figures get deployed unverified
replacement: Replace with attributable real case proof

name: Marketplace CTA in Client Site
symptom: Template vendor Buy for $129 and Monodrift cards remain in agency funnel
replacement: Remove publisher selling surface or isolate authorised marketplace identity

name: Search Affordance without Result Guarantee
symptom: Project or Journal search input has uncertain result behavior
replacement: Assert visible cards/results/reset/empty state with real search and filter

name: Unlimited Revisions Without Queue Caveat
symptom: Monthly subscription promises unlimited with queue/minimum-period caveats detached
replacement: Present capacity, turnaround, pause/cancel and billing accurately

name: Generic Social/Calendar Home Links
symptom: WhatsApp or Calendly CTAs point at provider home rather than business profile
replacement: Link actual brand-owned account or booking page

name: Duplicated Responsive DOM/Media Debt
symptom: Large differences in mobile image/video element counts after Framer hydration
replacement: Render only relevant art when possible; test real network and semantic heading exposure

name: Relative Social URL Internally Resolves to 404
symptom: instagram.com href is treated as local /instagram.com across all 19 declared pages
replacement: Use absolute verified https:// profile URL and crawl links

name: Sitemap Case or Article Missing from Index
symptom: Only 4 of 6 projects and 4 of 5 Labs are linked directly from main listing
replacement: Explicit Featured label and full archive/pagination access

name: Article H1 Assigned to Related Section
symptom: Lab detail title is H3 while MORE LABS is H1
replacement: Use article title H1; subsequent headings hierarchical

name: Contact Page Without H1
symptom: Contact 200 page has zero H1 in Chromium
replacement: Introduce visible or visually appropriate accessible H1

name: Template Awards or Team Claimed as Real
symptom: Sample campaigns, recognitions, New York staff and numbers read like real agency
replacement: Replace every claim with independently substantiated evidence

name: Social CTA Lands on Platform Home
symptom: Contact X LinkedIn Instagram Facebook WhatsApp generic origins and footer cross-targets
replacement: Owner-specific verified profiles/handoffs

name: Framerpod Creator Identity in Agency Footer
symptom: Creator X account, Framer template link, 404 demo route and generic framer.link
replacement: Remove template-vendor elements from genuine agency frontend

name: Decorative Canvas Without Runtime Boundary
symptom: Home contains 8 canvas desktop and 10 on mobile but performance unmeasured
replacement: Profile real animation FPS/bandwidth and support static reduced motion

name: Blog Topic and Body Contamination
symptom: Color psychology article has SEO and site-speed subheadings
replacement: Content QA for every article URL/H1/H2/paragraph/image pairing

name: Default Framer Tab Title Residue
symptom: Project detail blog and legal titles include My Framer Site
replacement: Use unique brand-owned document titles and canonical metadata

name: Fixture Agency Numbers Used as Proof
symptom: Source claims 56+ customers, 100 Pagespeed and huge conversion increases without independent source
replacement: Publish client-permitted attributable dated evidence only

name: Template Purchase Funnel Mixed with Agency CTA
symptom: Site includes $129 template and creator Templifica links
replacement: Strip template sales/creator copyright elements from real agency website

name: Project Total versus Published Case Count Confusion
symptom: Nav Projects 27 but sitemap holds only six project pages
replacement: Distinguish total completed engagements from browsable case portfolio

name: Contact Form Missing Project Brief
symptom: Only required Name and Email are visible on Contact
replacement: Optionally collect message/service intent or explicitly promise follow-up

name: Unverified Price Mode Switch
symptom: Per project and Monthly text visible but state change not established
replacement: Test selected tier and amounts with real pricing/backend policy

name: Conventional Agency Route Assumptions
symptom: /about /pricing /work /services are all actual 404 routes
replacement: Use /studio, /projects and homepage pricing for navigation

name: Competing Indexed Terms of Service
symptom: Two sitemap URLs /legal/terms-of-service and /legal/Terms%20of%20Service both 200 with self-canonicals and divergent observed snippets
replacement: Select reviewed authoritative terms path and redirect alternate after content review

name: Work Archive Hides Published Case Routes
symptom: Initial /work unique links include only 3 of 5 indexed client cases
replacement: Make Featured distinct from full directory and expose all five cases

name: Search Input Without Observed Result Change
symptom: Aurelis query and Whispers Architecture query did not reduce unique link sets in bounded tests
replacement: Implement real accessible visible-item filtering including no-match and clear

name: Semantically Missing and Misplaced H1
symptom: Contact Whispers legal and sampled case title use no correct leading H1 or a later CTA H1
replacement: Put one meaningful document H1 on each route and hide inactive responsive copies

name: Stale Future Availability in Homepage
symptom: Next Availability from September 14 2025 displayed in October 2026
replacement: Resolve time/availability from real schedule or remove dated claim

name: Conflicting Agency Mailing and Email Identity
symptom: Different Los Angeles mailing addresses and hello@create.com vs hello@createme.com appear in source
replacement: Audit real registered entity and use one verified contact/address

name: Creator Template Purchase Embedded in Agency Trust
symptom: Framerpod creator links and Tamas Bodo $129 marketplace sale coexist with simulated studio
replacement: Remove template publisher promotions for authentic client-facing deployment

name: Illustrative Client Results and Award Numbers
symptom: Claim 9 years 120+ cases 99% on-time 84% engagement or client awards without proof
replacement: Use traceable real source-dated metrics only

name: Direct File Load Contradiction
symptom: Prompt demanded file:// self-contained HTML; source README requires HTTP and observed direct file had zero canvas
replacement: Support truly self-contained module or clearly ship start.bat and validate HTTP-only

name: Physical Sky Model Mislabel
symptom: Tuned horizon/mid/zenith and sun powers are called Rayleigh/Mie without equations
replacement: Label art-directed analytic sky honestly or implement proper scattering

name: Two Scrolling Normal Maps Not Implemented
symptom: Source has sixteen analytic ripple slopes but no two scrolling procedural normal textures
replacement: Distinguish visual ripple mechanism from exact source prompt requirement

name: Every-frame Cubemap Re-render Cost
symptom: CubeCamera renders six sky faces each RAF before final main render
replacement: Cache or throttle slowly evolving environment lighting, measure GPU cost

name: No Low High Quality Switch
symptom: Source has 8/16 waves and DPR cap but no selectable wave/bloom detail tiers
replacement: Add measured runtime quality modes if benchmark demands them

name: Claimed Bloom and Vignette Not In Source
symptom: Native MSAA plus grain but no bloom composer or vignette
replacement: Implement conditional bloom and film edge tint or mark missing

name: Mistaking Demo Smoke for 60FPS
symptom: Software renderer recorded only 19 RAF callbacks/15s and no real 1080p laptop GPU measure
replacement: Benchmark real hardware and 60s continuity with frame pacing

name: CSS Resize without Verified Internal Buffer
symptom: 390px software browser CSS width but canvas drawing buffer remained old 1280x800 in sampled state
replacement: Verify canvas physical buffer, camera aspect, DPR and frame update after resize

name: Unbound Framer CMS Placeholder Linked
symptom: Site contains /labs/:LGnOksssn href returning HTTP404
replacement: Bind to an actual CMS permalink or remove navigation

name: Dead 404 Page Listed as Nav
symptom: Explicit /404 link appears in menu/footer and returns 404
replacement: Remove from primary menu, reserve 404 as fallback only

name: Form Markup Used as Proof of OAuth/OTP
symptom: FrameAuth badge and POST forms visible but backend verification not exercised, blank email/OTP valid
replacement: Require real session/OTP provider, native validation, error/retry and authenticated account guard

name: Framer H1 Breakpoint and CMS Duplication
symptom: Labs/auth lack H1; service phone H1 absent; articles can show duplicate H1 including More Articles
replacement: Ensure one primary H1 in accessible document at each viewport and correct related section hierarchy

name: Annual Billing Switch With Unproven Price Change
symptom: Plan Switch clicked but visible sampled price text unchanged
replacement: Connect Monthly/Yearly control to consistent amounts, accessible state and real checkout tests

name: Hidden Fields and Email Typo
symptom: Footer newsletter input sometimes name Emaiil; many hidden fields
replacement: Use stable Name/Email schema, server honeypot semantics and explicit success/error

name: Template Seller Upsell Leaks into End Customer Site
symptom: Buy Template $129 and New Template appear alongside Platform SaaS plan prices
replacement: Separate template commerce/vendor metadata from genuine client products

name: Generic Title Across Legal and Labs Index
symptom: Legal pages share Platform Modular Landing Page document title
replacement: Unique policy titles, meta descriptions/canonicals, owner-approved legal copy

name: Sitemap Lists True HTTP404
symptom: /404 declared in official sitemap but HTTP status is 404
replacement: Treat as fallback only and exclude from sitemap for indexed valid content

name: Only Seven of Ten Blog Detail Hrefs Initially Visible
symptom: Blog archive first state links seven articles despite ten live routes
replacement: Ensure all ten discoverable via pagination, related, filters or archive expansion

name: Integration Details Have No H1
symptom: Provider CMS detail pages have title text but no semantic h1 element
replacement: Use single real integration-name H1 with proper content hierarchy

name: Variant 3 Duplicate Desktop H1
symptom: /heroes/hero-v3 has two h1 DOM nodes at 1440 despite one on phone
replacement: Hide responsive duplicate from document/accessibility hierarchy or use one H1

name: Empty Waitlist Email Passes Native Validation
symptom: /waitlist input required=false, blank form checkValidity true
replacement: Required type=email, accessible error and server-side validation

name: CMS Partner Cards Mistaken for Real Integrations
symptom: 15 detail pages and Search Icon exist but no real API authorization/test
replacement: Mark marketing demo and prove OAuth/API handshake separately

name: Template Job Posting Mistaken for Current Vacancy
symptom: 6 careers pages publicly indexed and Apply now to /contact
replacement: Confirm real company role availability before deployment

name: Feature Comparison Mistaken for Live Billing
symptom: /pricing has compare plans and CTA but no verified payment/entitlement integration
replacement: Wire actual server billing and test subscription/plan states

name: Template Marketing Data and Seller Funnel Leaks
symptom: Mock revenue/projects/customer totals and Get template vendor CTA coexist with Superior product story
replacement: Use real source product proof, owner case studies and remove creator checkout from end-client site

name: Sitemap equals live product
symptom: Sitemap contains tens of thousands of stale or malformed URLs
replacement: Split sitemap declared URLs from separately verified page render and status

name: Stale Marketplace Promotion
symptom: NFT indexed URLs still occur although live home routes to a closure notice
replacement: Mark product retired; provide support handoff and accurate navigation

name: Unavailable Institution Landing
symptom: Institutional destination yielded generic error on inspected visit
replacement: Preserve graceful alternative and report failure; do not infer features

name: Stale Workflow Route
symptom: Auto-Invest deep path resolves into recurring Convert state
replacement: Track canonical destination and distinct in-app state

name: Financial Risk Buried
symptom: Dense futures and yield UI can obscure leverage or loss conditions
replacement: Keep contract leverage fees and relevant eligibility explicit

name: Demo Price Is Real Price
symptom: Static chart and stale market snapshot presented as live
replacement: Show mock fixtures or timestamp and data-quality state

name: Same Marketing Layout Everywhere
symptom: Editorial hero composition forced on trading order book
replacement: Assign density and navigation by route family

name: Account Content Stored as Reference
symptom: Logged-in reference browser leaks account and order details into shared audit artifacts
replacement: Record only public route structure and anonymized visible UI
